sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.430/2018 an application for overruled the office objection.
According to office objection, the present appeal is time barred by 8 days considering the limitation prescribed 45 days for the appeal.

This is an appeal against judgment dated 10.11.2017 passed in CRA No.75/2017 by Session Judge District Dhar/
Presiding Officer of Tribunal under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

According to Sub-section 6 of Section 71 of the Act, 2006,
any person aggrieved by any decision or order of the Tribunal may file an appeal to the High Court within sixty days from the date of communication of the decision or order of the Tribunal to him on any question of fact or law arising out of such order.
As stated above, the judgment was passed by the learned Tribunal on 10.11.2017 while the appeal is filed on 04.01.2018.
In view of the aforesaid, the present appeal is well within time.
Consequently, the application is allowed and the objection raised by the office is overruled.
Also heard on the question of admission.
On payment of P.F. within a week, notice be issued to the respondent no.2, returnable within six weeks.

Shri V. Khadav, learned Public Prosecutor accept notice on behalf of the respondent no.1/State,
therefore, no further notice is required to the respondent no.1.
In the meantime, record of the Tribunal be requisitioned.
List after six weeks alongwith the service report and record of the Tribunal.
(VIRENDER SINGH) JUDGE Praveen Khatri vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 January, 2018
